_comment: Image Comparison Pipeline — DAG configuration. The Dataflow job owns window/status management: it reads the earliest PENDING row from the lookup table, marks it RUNNING, runs, then marks DONE or FAILED. The DAG is a pure scheduler — no window fetching or status updates needed here.

pipeline._comment_filter: Leave human_filter_field blank to disable payload filtering.
pipeline._comment_segments: Each segment maps a pair of method values to a segment name written into the 'segment' column of every output row. For combined segments (multiple human payloads per image), list humanSubTypes with discriminatorField per sub-type. Use mergeArrayFields to concatenate shared arrays (e.g. documentProofs) across sub-types instead of replacing.

segments._comment: Combined authentication + docreview segment. Authentication and docreview human payloads arrive under different method values and are merged before AI comparison. The documentProofs array is tagged per sub-type, filtered, then concatenated into the merged record.
segments.name: authanddocreview

humanSubTypes._comment: Authentication sub-type: payload contains both verifiedData and documentProofs. Stamps every documentProofs item with authenticationType=Authentication.
humanSubTypes.name: authentication

humanSubTypes._comment: DocReview sub-type (merge base): payload contains documentProofs but NOT verifiedData. negativeDiscriminatorField ensures auth payloads (which also have documentProofs) are not misclassified here, regardless of sub-type ordering.
humanSubTypes.name: docreview
